component.name: VapourKit
component.summary: AI Video Upscaling GUI for VapourSynth

description.p: VapourKit is an advanced graphical interface for VapourSynth-powered AI video upscaling and processing. It supports ONNX Runtime (CPU) and TensorRT backends for model inference, with an extensible filter chain system.

ul.li: AI model upscaling with ONNX Runtime and TensorRT
Segment preview and live output monitoring
